name: ConfirmationDialog
description: `ConfirmationDialog` asks a user to confirm or cancel a consequential action.

props.name: cancelButtonContent
props.description: Label for the cancel button.

props.name: cancelButtonDisabled
props.description: Prevents cancelling.

props.name: cancelButtonLoading
props.description: Shows a spinner on the cancel button.

props.name: confirmButtonContent
props.description: Label for the confirm button. Name the action rather than saying `OK`.

props.name: confirmButtonDisabled
props.description: Prevents confirming, for when a precondition is not yet met.

props.name: confirmButtonLoading
props.description: Shows a spinner on the confirm button while the action is in flight.

props.name: dangerous
props.description: Styles confirmation as destructive and makes cancel the default focus.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting detail about what confirming will do.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => void | boolean | HTMLElement | null)
props.description: What receives focus when the dialog closes.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the dialog: `small` (480px), `large` (640px), or `auto` to fit its content.

props.name: initialFocus
props.type: "cancel" | "confirm" | boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((openType: InteractionType) => void | boolean | HTMLElement | null)
props.description: What receives focus when the dialog opens.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the dialog is dismissed or the cancel button is activated.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the confirm button is activated.

props.name: title
props.description: Question or statement the reader is confirming.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the dialog: `small` (296px), `medium` (320px), `large` (480px), `xlarge` (640px), or any CSS width.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the dialog: `small` (480px), `large` (640px), or `auto` to fit its content.
